name: spine-field-rules
body: Spine completion [autonomous]. requirements.requirement.field-rules drove only domain.value.field; `realised-by` applies only from a domain group|entity|service, so the spine dead-ended. Added `drives` -> domain.service.template-registry (the field rules are part of the template schema the registry owns). Added `implemented-by` solution.component.template-registry -> internal/template.CheckValues (enforces required/default/max_length/min/max etc. for field values). Path: field-rules -> template-registry -> solution.component.template-registry -> internal/template.CheckValues. Existing `drives` to domain.value.field kept.
